name: Board State Synchronization
description: Sync the control-plane board state (campaigns, missions, lanes, tasks) across devices with causal consistency.
purpose: Ensure the control-plane board state (campaigns, missions, lanes, tasks) is consistently replicated across devices with causal consistency guarantees.
acceptanceCriteria: Board entity operations are recorded in the operation log with causal metadata.
Devices converge to the same board state under causal consistency.
Conflict detection and resolution uses the taxonomy and merge registry.
Full-board sync can be triggered on demand or runs on a schedule.
